summary: Full-stack testing for DiCo/DiRi Italian termoidraulica MVP. Backend: 23/23 pytest tests passed (auth register/login/me/401, company default+PUT with abilitazioni, Clients CRUD+soft delete, Installations CRUD, Documents DICO/DIRI auto-numbering DICO-YYYY-NNNN / DIRI-YYYY-NNNN, sort desc, 404 on soft-deleted, invalid tipo 400). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): login screen tabs Accedi/Registrati visible, email+password login works, Dashboard shows Nuova DiCo / Nuova DiRi quick create cards and recent documents list, DiCo wizard end-to-end flow completes (step 1 committente → step 2 plant+intervento → step 3 → step 4 luogo+Genera) and navigates to /document/{id} with DICO-2026-0003 preview + Esporta PDF button, Registry tab opens /client/new modal with testID client-nome + save-client-button, created client appears in list, Profile tab loads field-denominazione, save-company-button, logout returns to login. DiRi wizard first steps work (diri-tecnico, diri-committente, step navigation). Minor React warning: uncontrolled→controlled input in src/components/ui.tsx:129 (TextField). Expo router warning about `(auth)` route group is cosmetic. No deprecated expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner usage detected.

ui_bugs.issue: React warning: 'A component is changing an uncontrolled input to be controlled.' Some TextField values start as undefined (e.g. tecnico.albo_professione, tecnico.albo_numero in diri.tsx, or other fields where state initializer may be partial). Fix: always default value to '' in TextField or in the owning state.

action_items: Low-priority: fix uncontrolled→controlled TextInput warning by defaulting all TextField `value` props to '' (TextField in src/components/ui.tsx can coerce `value ?? ''`, or ensure state objects (tecnico, ub, etc.) are initialized with all keys as empty strings).

Cosmetic: Expo Router warns 'No route named `(auth)` exists in nested children' — happens because `_layout.tsx` references `(auth)` group but it is auto-detected via file `app/(auth)/login.tsx`. Verify Stack.Screen name conventions in root _layout.tsx.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py (447 lines) is below the 700-line split threshold; routing is clean, uses async motor, excludes _id in projections, uses env vars for Mongo. Good.
Auth protects all data endpoints; bcrypt hashing; sessions expire after 7 days with TTL index on expires_at.
Soft-delete pattern consistent on clients/installations/documents (deleted_at field).

Document numbering uses count_documents which can race under concurrent POSTs (two parallel inserts could get same number). Low risk for a single-user app, but consider atomic $inc on a counters collection if numbering must be strictly unique.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (login + dashboard + DiCo end-to-end + Registry create + Profile save+logout verified; DiRi full end-to-end was flaky in Playwright on step transition — functionality is implemented and backend-verified via DIRI-YYYY-NNNN tests)

seed_data_creation: Reused existing credentials test@idraulico.it / pass1234. Created TEST_* clients, installation, documents during pytest (soft-deleted after). Also created DICO-2026-0003 and TEST_Playwright client via UI (left in DB).

Run `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. For UI, use mobile viewport 390x844. TestIDs are present on all key elements: tab-login/register, email-input, password-input, submit-button, google-button, create-dico-card, create-diri-card, add-registry-button, segment-clients/installations, client-nome, save-client-button, field-denominazione, save-company-button, logout-button, wizard-next, wizard-back, dico-committente, dico-luogo, dico-data, diri-tecnico, diri-committente, diri-luogo, diri-data, plant-*, interv-*, basis-*, att-*. rca_of_issue: No reproducible issue. Only one minor React dev warning (uncontrolled→controlled input) in TextField. Reproduction: open DiRi wizard, inspect console — warning triggered on first keystroke in albo fields. Mitigation: coerce value to '' in TextField component (`value={rest.value ?? ''}` plus controlled flag), or default state object keys to empty strings.
